metaDescription: Free minimal saas color palette with HEX codes, Tailwind CSS classes, CMYK values, and Pantone approximate references. Copy any color instantly.

faqs.question: Are the Pantone references exact matches?
faqs.answer: No. Pantone codes shown are the closest visual approximations. For production print work, always verify against a physical Pantone Fan Deck.

faqs.question: How are CMYK values calculated?
faqs.answer: CMYK values use the device-independent formula: K = 1 − max(R,G,B); C/M/Y derived from RGB ratios. Actual output depends on printer profile and paper.
